name: Waveshare Modbus RTU Relay (8-ch)
doc_revision: Waveshare Wiki 'Modbus RTU Relay' (page text mentions V3 protocol adopted from September 2024, V2 compatible); no document number
notes: Register table 'Address (HEX)' is the protocol (0-based) address: relays 1-8 = coils 0x0000-0x0007 (FC01/05/0F; 0xFF00 on, 0x0000 off, 0x5500 toggle). address_base=0, no conversion. Config registers written 4x2000 / 4x4000 / 4x8000 in the wiki are taken as holding registers 0x2000 (UART), 0x4000 (device address), 0x8000 (software version) (FC03; FC06 for 0x2000/0x4000). Write-only commands (all-relay 0x00FF, toggle 0x0100-0x0107/0x01FF, flash-on 0x0200-0x0207, flash-off 0x0400-0x0407) are not modelled as points because they are not readable. UART register 0x2000: high byte = parity (0x00-0x02), low byte = baud mode 0x00-0x07 (4800,9600,19200,38400,57600,115200,128000,256000). UNCLEAR: the wiki gives two contradictory parity mappings (0x01 even/0x02 odd in one section, 0x01 odd/0x02 even in another); the enum therefore only lists raw values with high byte 0 (no parity). Software version = value/100 (0x0064 = V1.00). Factory default baud/parity/address are NOT stated in the wiki; its examples use 9600, 8 data bits, no parity, address 0x01 - the connection block reflects those examples only (stop bits not stated).

points.name: UART Parameters
points.note: High byte parity (0-2), low byte baud mode 0-7. Parity mapping ambiguous in the wiki.
